title: Receipts/TypeCollectorMetadataBaseMemberTests.cs: edge-case test passes on head (1 tests): no defect shown; refutes 1 lens claim(s): logic-edge-1

refutes.claim: The new `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation` wrapper drops every diagnostic whose location is `Location.None` or outside the compilation, not just diagnostics about types owned by another assembly. Repro: a `[MessagePackObject]` class declared in source derives from a plain (non-`[MessagePackObject]`) base class in a referenced assembly, and that base has a public property without `[Key]`. The MsgPack004 diagnostic (an Error, per L2) is about the compiling assembly's own type, yet it is built with `Location.None` and silently discarded. The defining assembly never reports it either, because its base type is not a `[MessagePackObject]`. The wrapper's remark ('Their problems are reported by the compilation that defines them') is therefore false for inherited members. The build passes, and the generated formatter omits the unkeyed public member with no error at all. A correct fix would report MsgPack004 at the derived type's identifier instead of dropping it.
